conceptHeader.description: The Tapestry & Web of Trust community context. A kind-39998 anchor that tag-pinning events may STAMP (via an additional `z` tag) to declare that a pin belongs to this context's curated set — see contextual-pins ADR 0001. Referencing it is permissionless; a community-scoped client reads the stamped pins, per-POV, to surface the context's pinned tags. A deliberate proto-step toward a full Community Declaration: it carries no membership roster and confers no privileged authority.
